'''Yanix Dev''' was a distribution manager for the [[Karazak Slavers' Cooperative/Legends|Karazak Slavers Cooperative]] in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]]. He sold captured [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], although he appeared to be an expensively-clothed businessperson. Some people believed his great ego would be his downfall one day.
